para1: I'm Alok Kumar, a B.Tech Computer Science student at Bhai Jaita Subharti Engineering College, Meerut (Swami Vivekanand Subharti University), expected to graduate in 2027. I'm from Bettiah, Bihar, and currently based in Meerut, UP.
para2: I love building practical software — from face recognition systems to data dashboards — and I pair that with a genuine interest in tech writing and content creation. My goal is to bridge the gap between technical engineering and clear communication.
